kullanim: academic-pipeline: 'I want to write a research paper on <konu>' -> 10 asamali orkestra (RESEARCH deep-research -> WRITE -> 2.5 INTEGRITY -> REVIEW -> REVISE -> 3' RE-REVIEW -> 4' RE-REVISE -> 4.5 FINAL INTEGRITY -> FINALIZE -> 6 PROCESS SUMMARY); her asamadan sonra kullanici onayi bekler
